 59 │ function sortedBlocks(m: Message): Block[] {
 60 │   return [...(m.blocks ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq)
 61 │ }
 62 │ 
 63 │ function upsertTurn(turns: StepView[], step: number): StepView {
 64 │   const found = turns.find((t) => t.step === step)
 65 │   if (found) return found
 66 │   const fresh: StepView = { step, thinking: null, texts: [], calls: [] }
 67 │   turns.push(fresh)
 68 │   turns.sort((a, b) => a.step - b.step)
 69 │   return fresh
 70 │ }
 71 │ 
 72 │ function highestStep(turns: StepView[]): number {
 73 │   return turns.reduce((m, t) => Math.max(m, t.step), 0)
 74 │ }
 75 │ 
 76 │ function nextSeq(turns: StepView[]): number {
 77 │   let max = -1
 78 │   for (const t of turns) for (const c of t.calls) if (c.seq > max) max = c.seq
 79 │   return max + 1
 80 │ }
 81 │ 
 82 │ function makeCall(turns: StepView[], step: number, toolUseId: string, tool: string, input: Record<string, unknown>): ToolCallView {
 83 │   const cls = classifyCall(tool, input)
 84 │   return {
 85 │     seq: nextSeq(turns),
 86 │     step,
 87 │     toolUseId,
 88 │     tool,
 89 │     input,
 90 │     path: cls.path,
 91 │     command: cls.command,
 92 │     mutating: cls.mutating,
 93 │     read: cls.read,
 94 │     result: null,
 95 │     fault: null,
 96 │     recovered: false,
 97 │   }
 98 │ }
 99 │ 
100 │ function findCall(turns: StepView[], toolUseId: string): { turn: StepView; idx: number } | null {
101 │   for (const turn of turns) {
102 │     const idx = turn.calls.findIndex((c) => c.toolUseId === toolUseId)
103 │     if (idx >= 0) return { turn, idx }
104 │   }
105 │   return null
106 │ }
107 │ 
108 │ function attachResult(turns: StepView[], msg: Message, b: Block): void {
109 │   const toolUseId = b.tool_use_id
110 │   if (!toolUseId) return
111 │   const result = parseToolResult(toolUseId, b.text ?? '', b.is_error === true, b.duration_ms ?? 0)
112 │   if (result.exitCode === null && typeof b.exit_code === 'number') result.exitCode = b.exit_code
113 │   if (b.truncated) result.truncated = true
114 │   const fault = b.fault ?? null
115 │ 
116 │   const hit = findCall(turns, toolUseId)
117 │   if (hit) {
118 │     const prev = hit.turn.calls[hit.idx]!
119 │     hit.turn.calls[hit.idx] = { ...prev, result, fault: fault ?? prev.fault }
120 │     return
121 │   }
122 │   const step = typeof msg.step === 'number' ? msg.step : highestStep(turns)
123 │   const turn = upsertTurn(turns, step)
124 │   const synth = makeCall(turns, step, toolUseId, b.tool_name ?? 'unknown', {})
125 │   turn.calls.push({ ...synth, result, fault })
126 │ }

128 │ /**
129 │  * Build the transcript of one run from a conversation's persisted messages.
130 │  *
131 │  * Grouping follows ARCHITECTURE.md §4.5: the first user message's text block is the task prompt;
132 │  * each assistant message is one turn (thinking / text / tool_use blocks in seq order); the user
133 │  * message that follows carries the tool_result blocks, matched back by tool_use_id.
134 │  */
135 │ export function transcriptFromMessages(messages: Message[], run: RunSummary): Transcript {
136 │   const mine = messages.filter((m) => m.run_id === run.id).sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq)
137 │ 
138 │   let taskPrompt: string | null = null
139 │   const turns: StepView[] = []
140 │ 
141 │   for (const m of mine) {
142 │     const blocks = sortedBlocks(m)
143 │ 
144 │     if (m.role === 'user') {
145 │       for (const b of blocks) {
146 │         if (b.type === 'tool_result') {
147 │           attachResult(turns, m, b)
148 │         } else if (b.type === 'text' && taskPrompt === null && typeof b.text === 'string' && b.text.length > 0) {
149 │           taskPrompt = b.text
150 │         }
151 │       }
152 │       continue
153 │     }
154 │ 
155 │     const step = typeof m.step === 'number' ? m.step : highestStep(turns)
156 │     const turn = upsertTurn(turns, step)
157 │     for (const b of blocks) {
158 │       switch (b.type) {
159 │         case 'thinking': {
160 │           const text = b.text ?? ''
161 │           if (text.trim().length === 0) break
162 │           turn.thinking = turn.thinking ? `${turn.thinking}\n\n${text}` : text
163 │           break
164 │         }
165 │         case 'text': {
166 │           const text = b.text ?? ''
167 │           if (text.trim().length === 0) break
168 │           turn.texts.push(text)
169 │           break
170 │         }
171 │         case 'tool_use': {
172 │           const toolUseId = b.tool_use_id ?? b.id
173 │           if (turn.calls.some((c) => c.toolUseId === toolUseId)) break
174 │           const input = b.input && typeof b.input === 'object' ? b.input : {}
175 │           turn.calls.push(makeCall(turns, step, toolUseId, b.tool_name ?? 'unknown', input))
176 │           break
177 │         }
178 │         default:
179 │           break
180 │       }
181 │     }
182 │   }
183 │ 
184 │   const recovered = applyRecovery(turns)
185 │ 
186 │   return {
187 │     runId: run.id,
188 │     status: run.status,
189 │     scenarioId: run.scenario_id,
190 │     model: run.model,
191 │     taskPrompt,
192 │     turns: recovered.map((t) => ({ step: t.step, thinking: t.thinking, texts: t.texts, calls: t.calls })),

 73 │   | 'EACCES' // permission denied
 74 │   | 'ETIMEDOUT' // the response never arrived (ack lost, or a real client timeout)
 75 │   | 'EINVAL' // bad argument (path outside /workspace, bad mode, is-a-directory)
 76 │   | 'ESANDBOX' // the sandbox is gone/unavailable
 77 │   | 'ETRANSPORT' // harness <-> sandbox-env HTTP/MCP failure
 78 │   | 'EHARNESS' // the harness worker itself was interrupted while the call was in flight
 79 │   | 'EMODEL' // Anthropic API failure that ended the turn
 80 │   | 'EGYM' // gym control-plane (reset/observe/evaluate/delete) failure
 81 │   | 'EINTERNAL' // unexpected exception inside sandbox-env
 82 │   | 'ENOEPISODE' // missing/unknown X-Faultline-Episode header

 1 │ # Error and status taxonomy (contract for the UI, the ledger and the evidence)
 2 │ 
 3 │ > **Status (2026-09-12 19:45 EDT): contract, not yet implemented.** Defined in
 4 │ > `packages/common/faultline_common/schemas.py`; neither the harness nor sandbox-env emits these fields yet
 5 │ > (`PLAN.md` §2.11, lead implementing). Until they do, a UI must render them as absent/unknown, never infer them.
 6 │ 
 7 │ Two questions must be answerable for every failure a run shows: **who caused it** (`origin`) and
 8 │ **which layer really failed** (`layer`). The agent never gets these; the UI always does.
 9 │ 
10 │ ## `ErrorClass` (on every `tool.result` with `is_error`, on `fault.fired`, on `RunRecord.error_class`)
11 │ 
12 │ ```json
13 │ {"origin": "injected|staged|real", "layer": "boundary|filesystem|sandbox|transport|harness|model|gym",
14 │  "code": "ENOENT|EACCES|ETIMEDOUT|EINVAL|ESANDBOX|ETRANSPORT|EHARNESS|EMODEL|EGYM|EINTERNAL|ENOEPISODE",
15 │  "kind": "missing_file|denied_write|ack_lost|null", "label": "<fixed string below>",
16 │  "outcome_known": true|false, "side_effect_applied": true|false|null, "detail": "…"}
17 │ ```
18 │ 
19 │ | origin / layer | code(s) | label (render verbatim) | outcome_known | side effect |
20 │ |---|---|---|---|---|
21 │ | injected / boundary | ENOENT | `simulated: missing file (file still on disk)` | true | no |
22 │ | injected / boundary | EACCES | `simulated: write denied (nothing written)` | true | no |
23 │ | injected / boundary | ETIMEDOUT | `simulated: lost ack (write landed; response withheld)` | **false** | **yes** |
24 │ | staged / filesystem | ENOENT | `staged: file absent since reset` | true | n/a |
25 │ | real / filesystem | ENOENT, EACCES, EINVAL | `real: OS error in sandbox` | true | no |
26 │ | real / sandbox | ESANDBOX | `real: sandbox terminated or unavailable` | true | no |
27 │ | real / transport | ETRANSPORT, ETIMEDOUT | `real: transport failure harness<->sandbox-env (outcome unknown)` | **false** | unknown |
28 │ | real / harness | EHARNESS | `real: harness worker interrupted mid-call (outcome unknown)` | **false** | unknown (ledger has truth after the fact) |
29 │ | real / model | EMODEL | `real: model API error` | true | — |
30 │ | real / gym | EGYM | `real: gym control-plane failure` | true | — |
31 │ | real / boundary | EINTERNAL, ENOEPISODE | `real: internal error in sandbox-env` | true | no |
32 │ 
33 │ UI guidance: badge colour by `origin` (injected = amber "simulated", staged = amber "staged", real
34 │ = red "real"); show `label`; when `outcome_known: false` add "verify before retrying"; when the
35 │ ledger later resolves `side_effect_applied`, show it ("the write had landed").
36 │ 
37 │ ## Events
38 │ 
39 │ - `fault.fired` — `FaultFired` + `origin` (`injected` or `staged`). Never `real`.
40 │ - `interruption` — `Interruption` (always real): `{step, layer, code, label, tool_use_id?, tool?, path?, outcome_known, planned, resumed, worker_generation, at, detail}`. `planned: true` means a scenario `harness_faults` entry triggered it (a deliberate real failure).
41 │ - `run.resumed` — `{worker_generation, resumed_from_event_id, dangling_tool_use_id?, resumed_at}` emitted by the worker that picked the run up.
42 │ - `tool.result` — `data.error_class` present iff `is_error`; `data.fault` (FaultFired) present iff a fault fired for this call.
43 │ 
44 │ ## Run status
45 │ 
46 │ | status | meaning | score |
47 │ |---|---|---|
48 │ | `ok` | the agent submitted or ended; evaluation succeeded | number |
49 │ | `truncated` | step budget exhausted; still evaluated | number |
50 │ | `unevaluated` | the loop finished but `evaluate` failed (`error_class.layer: gym` or `sandbox`) — **not** the agent's fault | null |
51 │ | `interrupted` | a real interruption ended the run and no worker resumed it | null |
52 │ | `error` | the harness could not run the episode (model auth, reset failed, bug) | null |
53 │ 
54 │ `RunRecord.interruptions[]` lists every real interruption, `worker_generation` is 1 + the number of
55 │ resumes; a resumed run can still end `ok` (that is the point of the `worker-crash` scenario).
56 │ 
57 │ ## Scenario metadata
58 │ 
59 │ `Scenario.fault_kinds` (injected kinds in play) and `Scenario.harness_faults[]` (planned **real**
60 │ interruptions: `{kind: worker_crash|transport_abort, tool, path, nth, after_ms}`) are public so the
61 │ UI can show "includes a real harness interruption" on the card. The agent is never told either.
62 │ 
63 │ ## Ledger (released at evaluate)
64 │ 
65 │ `LedgerEntry.origin` (`injected|staged|real`, only when `outcome != ok`), `error_code`, and
66 │ `interrupted: true` when the harness reported that it never received the response (`POST
67 │ /episodes/{id}/interruptions`). `verified_before_rewrite` treats `ack_lost` rows and `interrupted`
68 │ rows identically.

1	/**
2	 * Pure fold: Event[] -> ViewState.
3	 *
4	 * Everything the UI renders comes from here, so the same function drives a live SSE run and a
5	 * bundled replay, and the interesting derivations (which call a fault hit, whether the agent
6	 * recovered) are unit-testable without a browser.
7	 *
8	 * Derivations worth naming:
9	 *   - `mutating` / `read` classification and argv-token path matching mirror
10	 *     services/sandbox-env/GRADING.md so the badge in the UI and the grader's checks agree.
11	 *   - `recovered`: a faulted call is recovered when a later call on the same path succeeds AND a
12	 *     successful *read* of that path happened at or before that success. Retrying blind does not
13	 *     count — that is precisely the behaviour the `lost-ack` scenario grades.
14	 */
15	
16	import type {
17	  Check,
18	  EpisodeSandboxData,
19	  ErrorClass,
20	  ErrorCode,
21	  ErrorLayer,
22	  ErrorOrigin,
23	  EvaluateResponse,
24	  EvaluationStatus,
25	  Event,
26	  FaultFired,
27	  FileDiff,
28	  FileEntry,
29	  Interruption,
30	  LogLine,
31	  RunRecord,
32	  RunResumedData,
33	  RunStatus,

40	export const LOG_BUFFER_LIMIT = 1000
41	
42	/** A run in one of these states will never produce another event. */
43	export const TERMINAL_STATUSES: readonly RunStatus[] = ['ok', 'error', 'truncated', 'unevaluated', 'interrupted']
44	
45	export function isTerminal(s: RunStatus | null | undefined): boolean {
46	  return !!s && TERMINAL_STATUSES.includes(s)
47	}

49	// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- view types
50	
51	export interface ToolResultView {
52	  toolUseId: string
53	  output: string
54	  isError: boolean
55	  durationMs: number
56	  /** Parsed JSON payload when the tool returned structured output. */
57	  stdout: string | null
58	  stderr: string | null
59	  content: string | null
60	  exitCode: number | null
61	  errorText: string | null
62	  errorCode: ErrorCode | null
63	  truncated: boolean
64	  bytesWritten: number | null
65	  entries: { name: string; type: string; size?: number | null }[] | null
66	  /** `tool.result.data.error_class` — present iff is_error on a harness that classifies errors. */
67	  errorClass: ErrorClass | null
68	  /** `tool.result.data.outcome` — how the call actually ended, as the harness reports it. */
69	  outcome: ToolOutcome | null
70	  /** `tool.result.data.attempts` — harness retries of this call (1 = none). */
71	  attempts: number | null
72	  /** `tool.result.data.sandbox` — which sandbox answered and whether it was alive. */
73	  sandbox: { id: string; alive: boolean } | null
74	}
75	
76	export interface ToolCallView {
77	  /** Global order across the run — the only reliable ordering when several calls share a step. */
78	  seq: number
79	  step: number
80	  toolUseId: string
81	  tool: string
82	  input: Record<string, unknown>
83	  /** Primary workspace path the call touches, if determinable. */
84	  path: string | null
85	  command: string | null
86	  mutating: boolean
87	  read: boolean
88	  result: ToolResultView | null
89	  fault: FaultFired | null
90	  recovered: boolean
91	}
92	
93	export interface StepView {
94	  step: number
95	  /** Summarised thinking for the step (`turn.thinking`), several blocks joined; null if none. */
96	  thinking: string | null
97	  texts: string[]
98	  calls: ToolCallView[]
99	}

101	/** One `messages.create` round trip (`llm.call`). Retries share a step with `attempt > 1`. */
102	export interface LlmCallView {
103	  step: number
104	  attempt: number
105	  model: string
106	  stopReason: string | null
107	  usage: Usage
108	  durationMs: number | null
109	  requestId: string | null
110	  error: string | null

113	export interface ViewState {
114	  runId: string | null
115	  status: RunStatus
116	  scenarioId: string | null
117	  model: string | null
118	  seed: number | null
119	  maxSteps: number
120	  episodeId: string | null
121	  taskPrompt: string | null
122	  anthropicWorkspace: string | null
123	  startedAt: string | null
124	  finishedAt: string | null
125	  /** Highest step seen so far. */
126	  step: number
127	  /**
128	   * Token totals. Accumulated from `llm.call` while the run is in flight (last attempt per step,
129	   * so a retried request is not double counted); `run.finished` and the RunRecord always win.
130	   */
131	  usage: Usage
132	  /** Every LLM round trip seen, in event order. */
133	  llmCalls: LlmCallView[]
134	  steps: StepView[]
135	  files: FileEntry[]
136	  diffs: FileDiff[]
137	  faults: FaultFired[]
138	  evaluation: EvaluateResponse | null
139	  logs: LogLine[]
140	  error: string | null
141	  durationMs: number | null
142	  lastEventId: number
143	  eventCount: number
144	  /** Every real interruption (`interruption` events; the RunRecord's list wins on seed). */
145	  interruptions: Interruption[]
146	  /** Every `run.resumed` (a fresh worker picked the run up), in order. */
147	  resumes: RunResumedData[]
148	  /** 1 + number of resumes (highest worker_generation seen). */
149	  workerGeneration: number
150	  /** Run-level classification: `run.finished.data.error_class` or `RunRecord.error_class`. */
151	  errorClass: ErrorClass | null
152	  /** The public scenario, when `episode.reset` carried it. */
153	  scenario: Scenario | null
154	  /** `episode.sandbox` notices (sandbox alive / terminated / replaced), in order. */
155	  sandboxEvents: EpisodeSandboxData[]
156	  /** Short sandbox id last seen (episode.reset / episode.sandbox / tool.result.sandbox). */
157	  sandboxId: string | null
158	  /** Last reported liveness; null until something reports it. */
159	  sandboxAlive: boolean | null
160	  /** `episode.reset.data.attempt` — >1 when the harness re-provisioned the workspace. */
161	  resetAttempt: number | null
162	  /** `run.finished.data.evaluation_status` / `evaluation_error`. */
163	  evaluationStatus: EvaluationStatus | null
164	  evaluationError: string | null

207	// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- path / verb helpers
208	
209	/** `"./src/x.py"`, `'/workspace/src/x.py'`, `"src/x.py"` all normalise to `src/x.py`. */
210	export function normalisePath(raw: string): string {
211	  let s = raw.trim()
212	  if (s.length >= 2 && ((s[0] === '"' && s.endsWith('"')) || (s[0] === "'" && s.endsWith("'")))) {
213	    s = s.slice(1, -1)
214	  }
215	  s = s.replace(/^\/workspace\//, '')
216	  s = s.replace(/^\.\//, '')
217	  s = s.replace(/^\/+/, '')
218	  // `ls src/ratelimiter/` and `read_file src/ratelimiter` name the same thing.
219	  if (s.length > 1) s = s.replace(/\/+$/, '')
220	  return s
221	}
222	
223	/** Cheap argv split: whitespace, honouring single/double quotes. Good enough for token matching. */
224	export function argvTokens(command: string): string[] {
225	  const out: string[] = []
226	  const re = /"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)'|(\S+)/g
227	  let m: RegExpExecArray | null
228	  while ((m = re.exec(command)) !== null) {
229	    out.push(m[1] ?? m[2] ?? m[3] ?? '')
230	  }
231	  return out
232	}
233	
234	const MUTATING_RE =
235	  /(>>?|\btee\b|\bsed\s+-i|\brm\b|\bmv\b|\bcp\b|\btouch\b|\bmkdir\b|\btruncate\b|\bpatch\b|\bgit\s+(apply|checkout|reset|restore))/
236	
237	const PY_WRITE_RE = /python[0-9.]*\s+.*-c[\s\S]*open\([\s\S]*['"][wa]\+?['"]/
238	
239	const READ_VERB_RE =
240	  /\b(cat|head|tail|grep|rg|wc|diff|less|cmp|sha256sum|md5sum|ls|stat|find|pytest|nl|od)\b|\bsed\s+-n\b|python[0-9.]*\s+-m\s+pytest/
241	
242	export function commandIsMutating(command: string): boolean {
243	  return MUTATING_RE.test(command) || PY_WRITE_RE.test(command)
244	}
245	
246	export function commandIsRead(command: string): boolean {
247	  return !commandIsMutating(command) && READ_VERB_RE.test(command)
248	}
249	
250	/** Does this call touch `path`? Direct for path tools; argv-token match for run_command. */
251	export function callTouches(call: ToolCallView, path: string): boolean {
252	  const target = normalisePath(path)
253	  if (call.tool === 'run_command') {
254	    if (!call.command) return false
255	    return argvTokens(call.command).some((t) => {
256	      const n = normalisePath(t)
257	      return n === target || n.endsWith(`/${target}`)
258	    })
259	  }
260	  return call.path !== null && call.path === target
261	}
262	
263	function inputPath(tool: string, input: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
264	  const raw = input?.path
265	  if (typeof raw === 'string' && raw.length > 0) return normalisePath(raw)
266	  if (tool === 'list_dir') return '.'
267	  return null
268	}
269	
270	export interface CallClassification {
271	  path: string | null
272	  command: string | null
273	  mutating: boolean
274	  read: boolean
275	}
276	
277	/**
278	 * Path / verb classification of a tool call from its name and input. Exported so the persisted
279	 * transcript path (transcript.ts) classifies exactly as the live fold does.
280	 */
281	export function classifyCall(tool: string, input: Record<string, unknown>): CallClassification {
282	  return classify(tool, input)
283	}
284	
285	function classify(tool: string, input: Record<string, unknown>): CallClassification {
286	  if (tool === 'run_command') {
287	    const command = typeof input?.command === 'string' ? (input.command as string) : null
288	    return {
289	      path: null,
290	      command,
291	      mutating: command ? commandIsMutating(command) : false,
292	      read: command ? commandIsRead(command) : false,
293	    }
294	  }
295	  if (tool === 'write_file') {
296	    return { path: inputPath(tool, input), command: null, mutating: true, read: false }
297	  }
298	  if (tool === 'read_file' || tool === 'list_dir') {
299	    return { path: inputPath(tool, input), command: null, mutating: false, read: true }
300	  }
301	  // `submit` and anything else the harness adds locally.
302	  return { path: inputPath(tool, input), command: null, mutating: false, read: false }
303	}
304	
305	// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- result parsing
306	
307	export function parseToolResult(
308	  toolUseId: string,
309	  output: string,
310	  isError: boolean,
311	  durationMs: number,
312	): ToolResultView {
313	  const base: ToolResultView = {
314	    toolUseId,
315	    output: output ?? '',
316	    isError,
317	    durationMs,
318	    stdout: null,
319	    stderr: null,
320	    content: null,
321	    exitCode: null,
322	    errorText: null,
323	    errorCode: null,
324	    truncated: false,
325	    bytesWritten: null,
326	    entries: null,
327	    errorClass: null,
328	    outcome: null,
329	    attempts: null,
330	    sandbox: null,
331	  }
332	  let parsed: unknown
333	  try {
334	    parsed = JSON.parse(output)
335	  } catch {
336	    if (isError) base.errorText = output
337	    return base
338	  }
339	  if (parsed === null || typeof parsed !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parsed)) return base
340	  const o = parsed as Record<string, unknown>
341	  if (typeof o.stdout === 'string') base.stdout = o.stdout
342	  if (typeof o.stderr === 'string') base.stderr = o.stderr
343	  if (typeof o.content === 'string') base.content = o.content
344	  if (typeof o.exit_code === 'number') base.exitCode = o.exit_code
345	  if (typeof o.truncated === 'boolean') base.truncated = o.truncated
346	  if (typeof o.bytes_written === 'number') base.bytesWritten = o.bytes_written
347	  if (typeof o.error === 'string') base.errorText = o.error
348	  if (typeof o.code === 'string' && (ERROR_CODES as readonly string[]).includes(o.code)) {
349	    base.errorCode = o.code as ErrorCode
350	  }
351	  if (Array.isArray(o.entries)) {
352	    base.entries = o.entries as ToolResultView['entries']
353	  }
354	  return base
355	}
356	
357	// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- recovery
358	
359	function flatten(steps: StepView[]): ToolCallView[] {
360	  const all: ToolCallView[] = []
361	  for (const s of steps) all.push(...s.calls)
362	  all.sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq)
363	  return all
364	}
365	
366	/**
367	 * Recompute `recovered` for every faulted call. Cheap (a run is tens of calls) and keeps the flag
368	 * correct as later events arrive.
369	 */
370	export function applyRecovery(steps: StepView[]): StepView[] {
371	  const all = flatten(steps)
372	  const recoveredIds = new Set<string>()
373	
374	  for (const c of all) {
375	    if (!c.fault) continue
376	    const path = normalisePath(c.fault.path || c.path || '')
377	    if (!path) continue
378	    const later = all.filter((x) => x.seq > c.seq)
379	    const successes = later.filter((x) => x.result && !x.result.isError && callTouches(x, path))
380	    if (successes.length === 0) continue
381	    const firstSuccessSeq = successes[0]!.seq
382	    const verified = later.some(
383	      (x) => x.seq <= firstSuccessSeq && x.read && x.result && !x.result.isError && callTouches(x, path),
384	    )
385	    if (verified) recoveredIds.add(c.toolUseId)
386	  }
387	
388	  if (recoveredIds.size === 0) {
389	    return steps.map((s) =>
390	      s.calls.some((c) => c.recovered) ? { ...s, calls: s.calls.map((c) => ({ ...c, recovered: false })) } : s,
391	    )
392	  }
393	  return steps.map((s) => ({
394	    ...s,
395	    calls: s.calls.map((c) => {
396	      const next = recoveredIds.has(c.toolUseId)
397	      return c.recovered === next ? c : { ...c, recovered: next }
398	    }),
399	  }))
400	}
401	
402	// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the fold
403	
404	function upsertStep(steps: StepView[], step: number): { steps: StepView[]; idx: number } {
405	  const idx = steps.findIndex((s) => s.step === step)
406	  if (idx >= 0) return { steps, idx }
407	  const next = [...steps, { step, thinking: null, texts: [], calls: [] }].sort((a, b) => a.step - b.step)
408	  return { steps: next, idx: next.findIndex((s) => s.step === step) }
409	}
410	
411	// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- usage
412	
413	function asUsage(v: unknown, fallback: Usage = { input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 0 }): Usage {
414	  const o = asRecord(v)
415	  const out: Usage = {
416	    input_tokens: num(o.input_tokens, fallback.input_tokens),
417	    output_tokens: num(o.output_tokens, fallback.output_tokens),
418	  }
419	  const cr = typeof o.cache_read_input_tokens === 'number' ? o.cache_read_input_tokens : fallback.cache_read_input_tokens
420	  const cc =
421	    typeof o.cache_creation_input_tokens === 'number'
422	      ? o.cache_creation_input_tokens
423	      : fallback.cache_creation_input_tokens
424	  if (cr !== undefined) out.cache_read_input_tokens = cr
425	  if (cc !== undefined) out.cache_creation_input_tokens = cc
426	  return out
427	}
428	
429	/**
430	 * Sum token usage over LLM calls, counting only the LAST attempt of each step so a request that
431	 * was retried after a 429/5xx is not billed twice in the header.
432	 */
433	export function sumLlmUsage(calls: LlmCallView[]): Usage {
434	  const lastPerStep = new Map<number, LlmCallView>()
435	  for (const c of calls) {
436	    const prev = lastPerStep.get(c.step)
437	    if (!prev || c.attempt >= prev.attempt) lastPerStep.set(c.step, c)
438	  }
439	  const out: Usage = { input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 0 }
440	  let cr = 0
441	  let cc = 0
442	  let sawCache = false
443	  for (const c of lastPerStep.values()) {
444	    out.input_tokens += c.usage.input_tokens
445	    out.output_tokens += c.usage.output_tokens
446	    if (typeof c.usage.cache_read_input_tokens === 'number') {
447	      cr += c.usage.cache_read_input_tokens
448	      sawCache = true
449	    }
450	    if (typeof c.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens === 'number') {
451	      cc += c.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens
452	      sawCache = true
453	    }
454	  }
455	  if (sawCache) {
456	    out.cache_read_input_tokens = cr
457	    out.cache_creation_input_tokens = cc
458	  }
459	  return out
460	}
461	
462	function usageIsEmpty(u: Usage | null | undefined): boolean {
463	  return !u || ((u.input_tokens ?? 0) === 0 && (u.output_tokens ?? 0) === 0)
464	}
465	
466	function asRecord(v: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
467	  return v !== null && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v) ? (v as Record<string, unknown>) : {}
468	}
469	
470	function num(v: unknown, fallback: number): number {
471	  return typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) ? v : fallback
472	}
473	
474	function str(v: unknown): string | null {
475	  return typeof v === 'string' ? v : null
476	}
477	
478	function asOrigin(v: unknown): ErrorOrigin | null {
479	  return typeof v === 'string' && (ERROR_ORIGINS as readonly string[]).includes(v) ? (v as ErrorOrigin) : null
480	}
481	
482	function asLayer(v: unknown): ErrorLayer | null {
483	  return typeof v === 'string' && (ERROR_LAYERS as readonly string[]).includes(v) ? (v as ErrorLayer) : null
484	}
485	
486	function asCode(v: unknown): ErrorCode | null {
487	  return typeof v === 'string' && (ERROR_CODES as readonly string[]).includes(v) ? (v as ErrorCode) : null
488	}
489	
490	function asFault(v: unknown): FaultFired | null {
491	  const o = asRecord(v)
492	  if (typeof o.kind !== 'string' || typeof o.path !== 'string') return null
493	  const fault: FaultFired = {
494	    step: num(o.step, 0),
495	    kind: o.kind as FaultFired['kind'],
496	    path: o.path,
497	    mode: (o.mode as FaultFired['mode']) ?? 'transient',
498	  }
499	  const origin = asOrigin(o.origin)
500	  const layer = asLayer(o.layer)
501	  if (origin) fault.origin = origin
502	  if (layer) fault.layer = layer
503	  if (typeof o.description === 'string' && o.description.length > 0) fault.description = o.description
504	  return fault
505	}
506	
507	/** Structural check for an ErrorClass payload; anything short of (origin, layer, code, label) is ignored. */
508	export function asErrorClass(v: unknown): ErrorClass | null {
509	  const o = asRecord(v)
510	  const origin = asOrigin(o.origin)
511	  const layer = asLayer(o.layer)
512	  const code = asCode(o.code)
513	  if (!origin || !layer || !code || typeof o.label !== 'string') return null
514	  return {
515	    origin,
516	    layer,
517	    code,
518	    kind: typeof o.kind === 'string' ? (o.kind as ErrorClass['kind']) : null,
519	    label: o.label,
520	    outcome_known: o.outcome_known !== false,
521	    side_effect_applied: typeof o.side_effect_applied === 'boolean' ? o.side_effect_applied : null,
522	    detail: str(o.detail),
523	  }
524	}
525	
526	function asInterruption(v: unknown, fallbackStep: number | null): Interruption | null {
527	  const o = asRecord(v)
528	  const layer = asLayer(o.layer)
529	  const code = asCode(o.code)
530	  if (!layer || !code) return null
531	  return {
532	    step: typeof o.step === 'number' ? o.step : fallbackStep,
533	    layer,
534	    code,
535	    label: str(o.label) ?? '',
536	    tool_use_id: str(o.tool_use_id),
537	    tool: str(o.tool) as Interruption['tool'],
538	    path: str(o.path),
539	    outcome_known: o.outcome_known === true,
540	    planned: o.planned === true,
541	    resumed: o.resumed === true,
542	    worker_generation: Math.max(1, Math.trunc(num(o.worker_generation, 1))),
543	    at: str(o.at) ?? '',
544	    detail: str(o.detail),
545	  }
546	}
547	
548	function asToolOutcome(v: unknown): ToolOutcome | null {
549	  return v === 'executed' || v === 'failed' || v === 'not_executed' || v === 'unknown' ? v : null
550	}
551	
552	function asSandboxRef(v: unknown): { id: string; alive: boolean } | null {
553	  const o = asRecord(v)
554	  if (typeof o.id !== 'string') return null
555	  return { id: o.id, alive: o.alive !== false }
556	}
557	
558	function asScenario(v: unknown): Scenario | null {
559	  const o = asRecord(v)
560	  if (typeof o.id !== 'string' || typeof o.title !== 'string') return null
561	  return o as unknown as Scenario
562	}
563	
564	function sameInterruption(a: Interruption, b: Interruption): boolean {
565	  if (a.tool_use_id && b.tool_use_id) return a.tool_use_id === b.tool_use_id
566	  return a.at === b.at && a.code === b.code && (a.step ?? null) === (b.step ?? null)
567	}
568	
569	function nextSeq(steps: StepView[]): number {
570	  let max = -1
571	  for (const s of steps) for (const c of s.calls) if (c.seq > max) max = c.seq
572	  return max + 1
573	}
574	
575	/** Fold one event into the view state. Pure: never mutates `state`. */
576	export function reduce(state: ViewState, ev: Event): ViewState {
577	  if (!ev || typeof ev.type !== 'string') return state
578	  const data = asRecord(ev.data)
579	  const step = typeof ev.step === 'number' ? ev.step : state.step
580	  const next: ViewState = {
581	    ...state,
582	    runId: state.runId ?? str(ev.run_id),
583	    lastEventId: typeof ev.id === 'number' && ev.id > state.lastEventId ? ev.id : state.lastEventId,
584	    eventCount: state.eventCount + 1,
585	    step: Math.max(state.step, typeof ev.step === 'number' ? ev.step : 0),
586	  }
587	
588	  switch (ev.type) {
589	    case 'run.started': {
590	      next.status = 'running'
591	      next.scenarioId = str(data.scenario_id) ?? next.scenarioId
592	      next.model = str(data.model) ?? next.model
593	      next.seed = typeof data.seed === 'number' ? data.seed : next.seed
594	      next.maxSteps = num(data.max_steps, next.maxSteps)
595	      next.anthropicWorkspace = str(data.anthropic_workspace) ?? next.anthropicWorkspace
596	      next.startedAt = state.startedAt ?? str(ev.ts)
597	      return next
598	    }
599	
600	    case 'episode.reset': {
601	      next.episodeId = str(data.episode_id) ?? next.episodeId
602	      next.taskPrompt = str(data.task_prompt) ?? next.taskPrompt
603	      if (Array.isArray(data.files)) next.files = data.files as FileEntry[]
604	      if (next.status === 'queued') next.status = 'running'
605	      next.scenario = asScenario(data.scenario) ?? next.scenario
606	      const sandboxId = str(data.sandbox_id)
607	      if (sandboxId) {

866	
867	export function reduceAll(events: Event[], from: ViewState = initialState()): ViewState {
868	  return events.reduce(reduce, from)
869	}
870	
871	/**
872	 * Seed the view from a whole RunRecord (page refresh mid-run, or a bundled demo). Record-level
873	 * fields win over anything the events implied, because the record is the harness's own summary.
874	 */
875	export function fromRunRecord(rec: RunRecord): ViewState {
876	  const folded = reduceAll(rec.events ?? [])
877	  // The record's usage is the harness's own running total and wins whenever it says anything.
878	  // The one exception is an in-flight record whose usage is still the {0,0} default while its
879	  // events already carry `llm.call` sums — showing zeros there would be a regression.
880	  const usage =
881	    rec.usage && (isTerminal(rec.status) || !usageIsEmpty(rec.usage) || usageIsEmpty(folded.usage))
882	      ? rec.usage
883	      : folded.usage
884	  return {
885	    ...folded,
886	    runId: rec.run_id ?? folded.runId,
887	    status: rec.status ?? folded.status,
888	    scenarioId: rec.scenario_id ?? folded.scenarioId,
889	    model: rec.model ?? folded.model,
890	    seed: rec.seed ?? folded.seed,
891	    maxSteps: rec.max_steps ?? folded.maxSteps,
892	    episodeId: rec.episode_id ?? folded.episodeId,
893	    taskPrompt: rec.task_prompt ?? folded.taskPrompt,
894	    startedAt: rec.created_at ?? folded.startedAt,
895	    finishedAt: rec.finished_at ?? folded.finishedAt,
896	    evaluation: rec.evaluation ?? folded.evaluation,
897	    usage,
898	    error: rec.error ?? folded.error,
899	    errorClass: rec.error_class ?? folded.errorClass,
900	    interruptions:
901	      Array.isArray(rec.interruptions) && rec.interruptions.length > 0 ? rec.interruptions : folded.interruptions,
902	    workerGeneration: Math.max(
903	      folded.workerGeneration,
904	      typeof rec.worker_generation === 'number' ? rec.worker_generation : 1,
905	    ),
906	  }
907	}
908	
909	// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- selectors
910	
911	export function allCalls(state: ViewState): ToolCallView[] {
912	  return flatten(state.steps)
913	}
914	
915	export function faultCount(state: ViewState): number {
916	  return allCalls(state).filter((c) => c.fault).length
917	}
918	
919	export function recoveredCount(state: ViewState): number {
920	  return allCalls(state).filter((c) => c.fault && c.recovered).length
921	}
922	
923	export function elapsedMs(state: ViewState, now: number = Date.now()): number | null {
924	  if (state.durationMs !== null) return state.durationMs
925	  if (!state.startedAt) return null
926	  const t0 = Date.parse(state.startedAt)
927	  if (Number.isNaN(t0)) return null
928	  const end = state.finishedAt ? Date.parse(state.finishedAt) : now
929	  return Math.max(0, (Number.isNaN(end) ? now : end) - t0)
930	}

5	 * in a mono chip, then status. Expanding a row reveals the call input, every result part the

7	 * and — for a mutating call whose path has a `FileDiff` — the unified diff.

90	export function resultParts(result: ToolResultView, path: string | null): ResultPart[] {
91	  const parts: ResultPart[] = []

93	  if (result.stdout) parts.push({ label: 'stdout', body: result.stdout, tone: 'plain' })
94	  if (result.stderr) parts.push({ label: 'stderr', body: result.stderr, tone: 'plain' })

106	    parts.push({ label: 'write', body: `${result.bytesWritten} bytes written`, tone: 'plain' })
107	  }
108	  if (parts.length === 0 && result.output) parts.push({ label: 'output', body: result.output, tone: 'plain' })

28	function summarise(call: ToolCallView): string {

36	function ResultBody({ result }: { result: ToolResultView }) {
37	  const parts: { label: string; body: string }[] = []
38	  if (result.errorText) parts.push({ label: result.errorCode ?? 'error', body: result.errorText })

40	  if (result.stderr) parts.push({ label: 'stderr', body: result.stderr })
41	  if (result.content !== null) parts.push({ label: 'content', body: result.content })
42	  if (result.entries) {

53	  return (

167	export function Timeline({ state, live }: { state: ViewState; live: boolean }) {
168	  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)

171	  // Auto-scroll while running, but yield the moment the reader scrolls up.

175	    const onScroll = () => {

180	  }, [])

188	  if (state.steps.length === 0) {
189	    return (

196	  }

198	  return (

200	      {state.taskPrompt ? (

202	          <div className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">

204	          </div>

206	            {state.taskPrompt}
207	          </p>

210	      <div className="relative">

212	        {state.steps.map((s) => (

1	/** Small presentation helpers. No React, no side effects — safe to unit test. */
2	
3	export function fmtDuration(ms: number | null | undefined): string {
4	  if (ms === null || ms === undefined || !Number.isFinite(ms)) return '—'
5	  if (ms < 1000) return `${Math.round(ms)} ms`
6	  const s = ms / 1000
7	  if (s < 60) return `${s.toFixed(s < 10 ? 1 : 0)} s`
8	  const m = Math.floor(s / 60)
9	  const rem = Math.round(s % 60)
10	  return `${m}m ${String(rem).padStart(2, '0')}s`
11	}
12	
13	export function fmtBytes(n: number | null | undefined): string {
14	  if (n === null || n === undefined || !Number.isFinite(n)) return '—'
15	  if (n < 1024) return `${n} B`
16	  if (n < 1024 * 1024) return `${(n / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`
17	  return `${(n / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`
18	}
19	
20	export function fmtTokens(n: number): string {
21	  if (n < 1000) return String(n)
22	  return `${(n / 1000).toFixed(1)}k`
23	}
24	
25	export function fmtTime(iso: string | null | undefined): string {
26	  if (!iso) return '—'
27	  const t = Date.parse(iso)
28	  if (Number.isNaN(t)) return '—'
29	  return new Date(t).toISOString().slice(11, 23) + 'Z'
30	}
31	
32	/** One-line preview of a command or path for a collapsed card header. */
33	export function oneLine(s: string, max = 120): string {
34	  const flat = s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
35	  return flat.length <= max ? flat : `${flat.slice(0, max - 1)}…`
36	}
37

39	  missing_file: 'missing_file',
40	  denied_write: 'denied_write',

42	}

46	  denied_write: 'A write was refused with EACCES and nothing was written.',
47	  ack_lost: 'The write landed, but the response timed out — the agent cannot know whether it applied.',
48	}

50	/** First 7 hex chars of a sha256, for a file-list column. */
51	export function shortSha(sha: string | null | undefined): string {
52	  return sha ? sha.slice(0, 7) : ''
53	}
54	
55	/**
56	 * The first sentence of a prompt, for a one-line summary. Breaks on `.`, `!` or `?` followed by
57	 * whitespace (optionally after a closing quote/bracket/backtick), so "0.2.0" and "README.md:" do
58	 * not end the sentence. Capped at `max` chars with an ellipsis.
59	 */
60	export function firstSentence(s: string | null | undefined, max = 240): string {
61	  if (!s) return ''
62	  const flat = s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
63	  const m = /[.!?][`'")\]]*(?=\s)/.exec(flat)
64	  const sentence = m ? flat.slice(0, m.index + m[0].length) : flat
65	  return sentence.length <= max ? sentence : `${sentence.slice(0, max - 1)}…`
66	}

69	export function plural(n: number, word: string, words = `${word}s`): string {
70	  return `${n} ${n === 1 ? word : words}`

3	 * (tool names and inputs, is_error, fault / error_class / outcome, exit codes, the grader's
4	 * checks). Message text is never parsed; the agent's own prose is only quoted.

6

8	import { codeText, taxonomyLabel } from './codes'
9	import { firstSentence } from './format'
10	import { normalisePath } from './reducer'
11	import type {
12	  ErrorClass,
13	  EvaluateResponse,
14	  Event,
15	  FaultFired,
16	  Scenario,
17	  ToolCallData,
18	  ToolResultData,

20	
21	export type StoryTone = 'info' | 'ok' | 'warn' | 'fail'

23	export interface Checkpoint {
24	  /** How many events are folded into the view at this checkpoint. */

27	  step: number | null
28	  /** Short label for the scrubber ("Start", "Step 4", "Verdict"). */
29	  label: string
30	  title: string
31	  text: string

35	export interface Story {
36	  checkpoints: Checkpoint[]

39	interface CallFacts {

45	}
46	
47	function describeCall(c: CallFacts): string {
48	  switch (c.tool) {
49	    case 'write_file':
50	      return `wrote ${c.path ?? 'a file'}`
51	    case 'read_file':
52	      return `read ${c.path ?? 'a file'}`
53	    case 'list_dir':
54	      return `listed ${c.path && c.path !== '.' ? c.path : 'the workspace'}`
55	    case 'submit':
56	      return 'submitted its summary'
57	    case 'run_command':
58	      return c.command ? `ran \`${c.command.length > 72 ? `${c.command.slice(0, 69)}…` : c.command}\`` : 'ran a command'
59	    default:
60	      return `called ${c.tool}`
61	  }
62	}
63	
64	function callFacts(d: ToolCallData): CallFacts {
65	  const input = d.input ?? {}
66	  const rawPath = typeof input.path === 'string' ? input.path : null
67	  const command = typeof input.command === 'string' ? input.command : null
68	  const mutating =
69	    d.tool === 'write_file' ||
70	    (d.tool === 'run_command' && !!command && /(>>?|\btee\b|\bsed\s+-i|\brm\b|\bmv\b|\bcp\b|\btouch\b|\bmkdir\b|\btruncate\b|\bpatch\b)/.test(command))
71	  let path = rawPath ? normalisePath(rawPath) : null
72	  if (!path && command) {
73	    // the first argv token that looks like a workspace file
74	    const tok = command.split(/\s+/).find((t) => /^[\w./-]+\.(py|md|json|ini|txt|toml|cfg)$/.test(t.replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')))
75	    path = tok ? normalisePath(tok) : null
76	  }
77	  return { toolUseId: d.tool_use_id, tool: String(d.tool), path, command, mutating }
78	}

80	function exitCodeOf(output: string): number | null {
81	  try {
82	    const v = JSON.parse(output) as { exit_code?: unknown }
83	    return typeof v?.exit_code === 'number' ? v.exit_code : null
84	  } catch {
85	    return null
86	  }
87	}

90	  if (ec) {

123	  const bad = ev.checks.filter((c) => !c.ok)
124	  if (ev.checks.length) {
125	    out.push(`Recovery checks from the ledger: ${ok.length}/${ev.checks.length} passed${bad.length ? ` — failed: ${bad.map((c) => checkText(c.id).whenFailed).join('; ')}` : ''}.`)
126	  }
127	  out.push(`Score ${Math.round(ev.score)}/100.`)
128	  return out
129	}
130	
131	export function buildStory(events: Event[], scenario: Scenario | null): Story {
132	  const checkpoints: Checkpoint[] = []
133	  if (events.length === 0) return { checkpoints }
134	
135	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- prologue
136	  let taskPrompt: string | null = null
137	  let model: string | null = null
138	  let firstStepIdx = events.findIndex((e) => typeof e.step === 'number' && e.step > 0 && e.type !== 'log')
139	  if (firstStepIdx < 0) firstStepIdx = events.length
140	  for (const e of events.slice(0, firstStepIdx)) {
141	    if (e.type === 'episode.reset' && typeof e.data.task_prompt === 'string') taskPrompt = e.data.task_prompt
142	    if (e.type === 'run.started' && typeof e.data.model === 'string') model = e.data.model
143	  }
144	  const injected = (scenario?.fault_kinds ?? []).map((k) => taxonomyLabel('injected', k, 'boundary') ?? `simulated: ${k}`)
145	  const real = scenario?.harness_faults ?? []
146	  const pro: string[] = []
147	  pro.push(taskPrompt ? `The task: ${firstSentence(taskPrompt, 220)}` : 'The agent is given a task in a sandboxed copy of a small Python repo.')
148	  if (model) pro.push(`The model is ${model}.`)
149	  if (injected.length) pro.push(`Somewhere along the way the environment will inject ${injected.length === 1 ? 'one failure' : `${injected.length} failures`}: ${injected.join('; ')}.`)
150	  if (real.length) pro.push(`It also includes a real harness interruption (${real.map((f) => f.kind.replace('_', ' ')).join(', ')}) — the worker really is killed.`)
151	  pro.push('The agent is not told any of this.')
152	  checkpoints.push({
153	    index: Math.max(firstStepIdx, 0),
154	    step: null,
155	    label: 'Start',
156	    title: scenario?.title ?? 'The task',
157	    text: pro.join(' '),
158	    tone: 'info',
159	  })
160	
161	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- steps
162	  const stepOrder: number[] = []
163	  const byStep = new Map<number, Event[]>()
164	  for (const e of events) {
165	    if (typeof e.step !== 'number' || e.step <= 0 || e.type === 'log') continue
166	    if (!byStep.has(e.step)) {
167	      byStep.set(e.step, [])
168	      stepOrder.push(e.step)
169	    }
170	    byStep.get(e.step)!.push(e)
171	  }
172	  const lastIndexOfStep = new Map<number, number>()
173	  events.forEach((e, i) => {
174	    if (typeof e.step === 'number' && e.step > 0) lastIndexOfStep.set(e.step, i + 1)
175	  })
176	
177	  const calls = new Map<string, CallFacts>()
178	  /** paths whose last write ended with an unknown outcome and have not been read back since */
179	  const unverified = new Map<string, number>()
180	  const lastEvaluated = events.filter((e) => e.type === 'episode.evaluated').at(-1)
181	  const evaluation = lastEvaluated ? (lastEvaluated.data as unknown as EvaluateResponse) : null
182	
183	  for (const step of stepOrder) {
184	    const evs = byStep.get(step)!
185	    const sentences: string[] = []
186	    let tone: StoryTone = 'info'
187	    const prose = evs.find((e) => e.type === 'turn.text' && typeof e.data.text === 'string')
188	    if (prose) {
189	      const quote = firstSentence(String(prose.data.text), 160)
190	      if (quote) sentences.push(`The agent: “${quote}”`)
191	    }
192	    const stepCalls = evs.filter((e) => e.type === 'tool.call').map((e) => callFacts(e.data as unknown as ToolCallData))
193	    for (const c of stepCalls) calls.set(c.toolUseId, c)
194	    const results = evs.filter((e) => e.type === 'tool.result').map((e) => e.data as unknown as ToolResultData)
195	    const faultsFired = evs.filter((e) => e.type === 'fault.fired').map((e) => e.data as unknown as FaultFired)
196	
197	    const actions: string[] = []
198	    for (const c of stepCalls) {
199	      const r = results.find((x) => x.tool_use_id === c.toolUseId)
200	      let s = `It ${describeCall(c)}`
201	      if (r) {
202	        const ec = (r as ToolResultData & { error_class?: ErrorClass | null }).error_class ?? null
203	        const fault = r.fault ?? faultsFired.find((f) => f.step === step && (!c.path || normalisePath(f.path) === c.path)) ?? null
204	        const exit = exitCodeOf(r.output)
205	        if (r.is_error) {
206	          const fs = faultSentence(fault, ec)
207	          if (fs) {
208	            s += `. ${fs.text}`
209	            tone = fs.tone === 'fail' ? 'fail' : tone === 'fail' ? 'fail' : 'warn'
210	            if (fs.unknown && c.path) unverified.set(c.path, step)
211	          } else {
212	            s += '. It failed — the record carries no classification, so what happened is unknown.'
213	            tone = tone === 'fail' ? 'fail' : 'warn'
214	          }
215	        } else if (exit !== null && exit !== 0) {
216	          s += ` — exit code ${exit}${c.command && /pytest/.test(c.command) ? ': the tests failed' : ''}.`
217	          tone = tone === 'info' ? 'warn' : tone
218	        } else if (c.command && /pytest/.test(c.command)) {
219	          s += ' — the test suite passed.'
220	          tone = tone === 'info' ? 'ok' : tone
221	        } else {
222	          s += '.'
223	        }
224	        // recovery observations (derived from call order, not from text)
225	        if (!r.is_error && c.path && unverified.has(c.path)) {
226	          if (!c.mutating) {
227	            s += ` That read-back is the right move after a lost acknowledgement: now it knows the file's real contents.`
228	            unverified.delete(c.path)
229	            tone = tone === 'fail' ? 'fail' : 'ok'
230	          } else {
231	            s += ` It wrote ${c.path} again without reading it back — if the first write landed, this duplicates it.`
232	            tone = 'warn'
233	          }
234	        }
235	      } else {
236	        s += ' (no result recorded).'
237	      }
238	      actions.push(s)
239	    }
240	    sentences.push(...actions)
241	    if (stepCalls.length === 0 && !prose) sentences.push('Nothing observable happened in this step.')
242	
243	    checkpoints.push({
244	      index: lastIndexOfStep.get(step) ?? events.length,
245	      step,
246	      label: `Step ${step}`,
247	      title: `Step ${step}`,
248	      text: sentences.join(' '),
249	      tone,
250	    })
251	  }
252	
253	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- epilogue
254	  const finished = events.filter((e) => e.type === 'run.finished').at(-1)
255	  const status = finished ? String(finished.data.status ?? '') : ''
256	  const epi: string[] = []
257	  let epiTone: StoryTone = 'info'
258	  if (evaluation) {
259	    epi.push(...evaluationSentences(evaluation))
260	    epiTone = evaluation.passed && evaluation.checks.every((c) => c.ok) ? 'ok' : 'warn'
261	  }
262	  if (status && status !== 'ok') {
263	    const ec = (finished?.data.error_class as ErrorClass | undefined) ?? null
264	    epi.push(`The run ended ${status}${ec ? `: ${ec.label}` : typeof finished?.data.error === 'string' ? `: ${firstSentence(String(finished.data.error), 140)}` : ''}.`)
265	    epiTone = status === 'truncated' ? 'warn' : 'fail'
266	  }
267	  if (!evaluation && !status) epi.push('The run has not been graded.')
268	  checkpoints.push({
269	    index: events.length,
270	    step: null,
271	    label: 'Verdict',
272	    title: evaluation ? `Verdict: ${Math.round(evaluation.score)}/100` : 'Verdict',
273	    text: epi.join(' '),
274	    tone: epiTone,
275	  })
276	
277	  return { checkpoints }
278	}
279	
280	/** The checkpoint the cursor is currently inside (the last one whose index <= cursor). */
281	export function checkpointAt(story: Story, cursor: number): number {
282	  let idx = 0
283	  story.checkpoints.forEach((c, i) => {
284	    if (c.index <= cursor) idx = i
285	  })
286	  return idx
287	}

71	function dayBucket(iso: string, now = new Date()): string {
72	  const d = new Date(iso)
73	  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return 'Earlier'
74	  const startOfToday = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()).getTime()
75	  const t = d.getTime()
76	  if (t >= startOfToday) return 'Today'
77	  if (t >= startOfToday - 86_400_000) return 'Yesterday'
78	  if (t >= startOfToday - 6 * 86_400_000) return 'Previous 7 days'
79	  return 'Earlier'
80	}
81	
82	function groupByDay(items: ConversationSummary[]): { label: string; items: ConversationSummary[] }[] {
83	  const order = ['Today', 'Yesterday', 'Previous 7 days', 'Earlier']
84	  const buckets = new Map<string, ConversationSummary[]>()
85	  for (const c of items) {
86	    const key = dayBucket(c.updated_at || c.created_at)
87	    const arr = buckets.get(key) ?? []
88	    arr.push(c)
89	    buckets.set(key, arr)
90	  }
91	  return order.filter((k) => buckets.has(k)).map((k) => ({ label: k, items: buckets.get(k)! }))
92	}

1	/**
2	 * Owns one run's view state and its transport.
3	 *
4	 * Two sources, one reducer:
5	 *   - live : GET /runs/{id} to seed (so a page refresh mid-run restores everything), then
6	 *            subscribeRun() for the tail. The seed is best-effort — a run created a moment ago can
7	 *            404 until the harness has written it — so a failed seed must NOT skip the tail.
8	 *   - demo : a bundled RunRecord replayed at 400 ms per event, with no backend at all.
9	 */
10	
11	import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
12	
13	import { HarnessClient, subscribeRun, type Subscription, type TransportState } from '@/lib/api'
14	import { getLogger } from '@/lib/log'
15	import { fromRunRecord, initialState, reduce, type ViewState } from '@/lib/reducer'
16	import { DEMOS, loadDemo, playReplay, type ReplayHandle } from '@/lib/replay'
17	import type { Event } from '@/lib/types'
18	
19	const log = getLogger('web')
20	
21	export type RunSource =
22	  | { kind: 'none' }
23	  | { kind: 'live'; runId: string }
24	  | { kind: 'demo'; demoId: string }
25	
26	export interface RunViewState {
27	  state: ViewState
28	  transport: TransportState | null
29	  loadError: string | null
30	  loading: boolean
31	  /** True while a bundled demo is still emitting events. */
32	  replaying: boolean
33	}
34	
35	export function useRunView(client: HarnessClient | null, source: RunSource): RunViewState {
36	  const [state, setState] = useState<ViewState>(initialState)
37	  const [transport, setTransport] = useState<TransportState | null>(null)
38	  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null)
39	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(source.kind !== 'none')
40	  const [replaying, setReplaying] = useState(false)
41	
42	  const subRef = useRef<Subscription | null>(null)
43	  const replayRef = useRef<ReplayHandle | null>(null)
44	
45	  const push = useCallback((events: Event[]) => {
46	    setState((prev) => events.reduce(reduce, prev))
47	  }, [])
48	
49	  const key =
50	    source.kind === 'live'
51	      ? `live:${source.runId}`
52	      : source.kind === 'demo'
53	        ? `demo:${source.demoId}`
54	        : 'none'
55	
56	  useEffect(() => {
57	    let cancelled = false
58	
59	    const teardown = () => {
60	      subRef.current?.close()
61	      subRef.current = null
62	      replayRef.current?.stop()
63	      replayRef.current = null
64	    }
65	
66	    teardown()
67	    setState(initialState())
68	    setTransport(null)
69	    setLoadError(null)
70	    setReplaying(false)
71	
72	    const stop = () => {
73	      cancelled = true
74	      teardown()
75	    }
76	
77	    if (key === 'none') {
78	      setLoading(false)
79	      return stop
80	    }
81	
82	    setLoading(true)
83	
84	    if (key.startsWith('demo:')) {
85	      const demoId = key.slice('demo:'.length)
86	      const meta = DEMOS.find((d) => d.id === demoId)
87	      void (async () => {
88	        try {
89	          if (!meta) throw new Error(`no bundled demo named "${demoId}"`)
90	          const rec = await loadDemo(meta.file)
91	          if (cancelled) return
92	          // Seed identity from the record, but let the replayed events drive status and score.
93	          const seeded = fromRunRecord({ ...rec, events: [], evaluation: null, finished_at: null })
94	          setState({ ...seeded, status: 'running', evaluation: null })
95	          setLoading(false)
96	          setReplaying(true)
97	          log.info('demo.loaded', 'bundled demo loaded', { demo: demoId, events: rec.events.length })
98	          replayRef.current = playReplay({
99	            events: rec.events,
100	            onEvents: push,
101	            onDone: () => {
102	              if (!cancelled) setReplaying(false)
103	              log.info('demo.finished', 'replay complete', { demo: demoId })
104	            },
105	          })
106	        } catch (err) {
107	          if (cancelled) return
108	          setLoading(false)
109	          setLoadError(String(err))
110	          log.error('demo.error', 'failed to load bundled run', { demo: demoId, error: String(err) })
111	        }
112	      })()
113	      return stop
114	    }
115	
116	    const runId = key.slice('live:'.length)
117	    if (!client) {
118	      setLoading(false)
119	      setLoadError('harness URL not resolved yet')
120	      return stop
121	    }
122	
123	    void (async () => {
124	      let from = -1
125	      try {
126	        const rec = await client.getRun(runId)
127	        if (cancelled) return
128	        setState(fromRunRecord(rec))
129	        from = rec.events?.length ? Math.max(...rec.events.map((e) => e.id)) : -1
130	        log.info('run.restored', 'seeded view from GET /runs/{id}', {
131	          run_id: runId,
132	          events: rec.events?.length ?? 0,
133	          status: rec.status,
134	        })
135	      } catch (err) {
136	        if (cancelled) return
137	        setLoadError(String(err))
138	        log.warn('run.load_error', 'GET /runs failed; relying on the stream', {
139	          run_id: runId,
140	          error: String(err),
141	        })
142	      }
143	      if (cancelled) return
144	      setLoading(false)
145	      subRef.current = subscribeRun({
146	        base: client.base,
147	        runId,
148	        lastEventId: from,
149	        onEvents: push,
150	        onRecord: (r) => {
151	          // The polling fallback returns the whole record; take the summary fields from it so the
152	          // header stays right even if a `run.finished` event was missed.
153	          setState((prev) => ({
154	            ...prev,
155	            status: r.status ?? prev.status,
156	            usage: r.usage ?? prev.usage,
157	            evaluation: r.evaluation ?? prev.evaluation,
158	            error: r.error ?? prev.error,
159	            finishedAt: r.finished_at ?? prev.finishedAt,
160	          }))
161	        },
162	        onTransport: (t) => {
163	          if (!cancelled) setTransport(t)
164	        },
165	      })
166	    })()
167	
168	    return stop
169	  }, [key, client, push])
170	
171	  return { state, transport, loadError, loading, replaying }
172	}

1	/**
2	 * Demo replay: play a bundled RunRecord's events back with fixed spacing so the UI is fully
3	 * exercisable with no backend at all (a provider outage or a cold harness must not leave a reviewer
4	 * looking at an empty page).
5	 *
6	 * `public/demo/<scenario>.json` holds a RunRecord; scripts/export_demo.py writes those from a real
7	 * run under runs/. See public/demo/README.md.
8	 */
9	
10	import { getLogger } from './log'
11	import type { Event, RunRecord } from './types'
12	
13	const log = getLogger('web')
14	
15	export const DEMO_STEP_MS = 400
16	
17	export interface DemoMeta {
18	  id: string
19	  label: string
20	  file: string
21	}
22	
23	/** Demos shipped in public/demo. Adding a file here is all it takes to expose a new replay. */
24	export const DEMOS: DemoMeta[] = [
25	  // Real captures: claude-haiku-4-5 on the deployed stack (2026-09-12), exported with
26	  // scripts/export_demo.py. Ids match scenario ids so the scenario table offers them via demoFor().
27	  { id: 'lost-ack', label: 'lost-ack', file: '/demo/lost-ack.json' },
28	  { id: 'locked-file', label: 'locked-file', file: '/demo/locked-file.json' },
29	  { id: 'missing-config', label: 'missing-config', file: '/demo/missing-config.json' },
30	  { id: 'gauntlet', label: 'gauntlet', file: '/demo/gauntlet.json' },
31	]
32	
33	export function demoFor(scenarioId: string): DemoMeta | undefined {
34	  return DEMOS.find((d) => d.id === scenarioId)
35	}
36	
37	export async function loadDemo(
38	  file: string,
39	  fetchImpl: typeof fetch = fetch,
40	): Promise<RunRecord> {
41	  const res = await fetchImpl(file, { cache: 'no-store' })
42	  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`demo ${file} not found (${res.status})`)
43	  const rec = (await res.json()) as RunRecord
44	  if (!Array.isArray(rec?.events)) throw new Error(`demo ${file} has no events`)
45	  return rec
46	}
47	
48	export interface ReplayHandle {
49	  stop: () => void
50	}
51	
52	export interface ReplayOptions {
53	  events: Event[]
54	  onEvents: (events: Event[]) => void
55	  onDone?: () => void
56	  stepMs?: number
57	  setTimeoutImpl?: (fn: () => void, ms: number) => unknown
58	  clearTimeoutImpl?: (h: unknown) => void
59	}
60	
61	/**
62	 * Emit `events` one at a time, `stepMs` apart. Consecutive events that belong to the same instant
63	 * (a tool.call and its tool.result share a step) still get their own tick — the point of the demo
64	 * is to show the timeline filling in, not to simulate real latency.
65	 */
66	export function playReplay(opts: ReplayOptions): ReplayHandle {
67	  const {
68	    events,
69	    onEvents,
70	    onDone,
71	    stepMs = DEMO_STEP_MS,
72	    setTimeoutImpl = (fn, ms) => setTimeout(fn, ms),
73	    clearTimeoutImpl = (h) => clearTimeout(h as ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>),
74	  } = opts
75	
76	  let i = 0
77	  let handle: unknown = null
78	  let stopped = false
79	
80	  log.info('replay.start', 'playing bundled demo', { events: events.length, step_ms: stepMs })
81	
82	  const tick = () => {
83	    if (stopped) return
84	    const ev = events[i]
85	    i += 1
86	    if (!ev) {
87	      log.info('replay.done', 'demo finished', { events: events.length })
88	      onDone?.()
89	      return
90	    }
91	    onEvents([ev])
92	    handle = setTimeoutImpl(tick, stepMs)
93	  }
94	
95	  // First event lands immediately so the view is never blank.
96	  tick()
97	
98	  return {
99	    stop: () => {
100	      if (stopped) return
101	      stopped = true
102	      if (handle !== null) clearTimeoutImpl(handle)
103	      log.info('replay.stop', 'demo stopped by caller', { delivered: i })
104	    },
105	  }
106	}

27	/**

37	  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(true)

41	    setRecord(null)

43	    setError(null)

54	      } catch (err) {
55	        if (cancelled) return
56	        setError(String(err))
57	        log.error('replay.error', 'failed to load bundled run', { demo: demoId, error: String(err) })
58	      } finally {

67	              conversation_id: conv.id,
68	              scenario_id: p.scenarioId,
69	              model: p.model,
70	            })
71	            navigate({ kind: 'conversation', id: conv.id, runId: r.run_id })
72	            conversations.refresh()

74	          } catch (err) {
75	            if (!isNotFound(err)) throw err
76	            log.warn('conversations.unavailable', 'no /conversations routes on this harness; using POST /runs', {
77	              error: String(err),
78	            })
79	          }
80	        }
81	
82	        const r = await client.createRun({ scenario_id: p.scenarioId, model: p.model, seed: p.seed })
83	        log.info('run.started', 'run accepted (POST /runs)', {
84	          run_id: r.run_id,
85	          conversation_id: r.conversation_id ?? null,
86	          scenario_id: p.scenarioId,
87	          model: p.model,
88	        })
89	        if (r.conversation_id) navigate({ kind: 'conversation', id: r.conversation_id, runId: r.run_id })
90	        else navigate({ kind: 'run', runId: r.run_id })
91	        conversations.refresh()
92	        return r.run_id
93	      } catch (err) {

96	          scenario_id: p.scenarioId,
97	          error: String(err),
98	        })
99	        return null
100	      } finally {
101	        setBusy(false)
102	      }
103	    },
104	    [harness.client, conversations],
105	  )

107	  return { start, busy, error }

1	/**
2	 * The conversation rail: GET /conversations for the current identity.
3	 *
4	 * A harness without the Store answers 404 on this route. That is not an error — the app still
5	 * runs episodes through POST /runs — so it lands in `available: false` and the rail hides itself.
6	 *
7	 * State is the last *loaded* answer, keyed by the request that produced it (client identity +
8	 * refresh epoch); `loading` is derived from whether that key is current. No setState runs
9	 * synchronously inside the effect, so a refresh or an identity reset costs one render, not two.
10	 */
11	
12	import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
13	
14	import { HarnessClient, isNotFound } from '@/lib/api'
15	import { getLogger } from '@/lib/log'
16	import type { ConversationSummary } from '@/lib/types'
17	
18	const log = getLogger('web')
19	
20	export interface ConversationsState {
21	  items: ConversationSummary[]
22	  loading: boolean
23	  /** Transport / server error text; never set for a 404. */
24	  error: string | null
25	  /** null until the first answer; false when the harness has no /conversations routes. */
26	  available: boolean | null
27	  refresh: () => void
28	}
29	
30	interface Loaded {
31	  client: HarnessClient
32	  epoch: number
33	  items: ConversationSummary[]
34	  available: boolean | null
35	  error: string | null
36	}
37	
38	export function useConversations(client: HarnessClient | null): ConversationsState {
39	  const [epoch, setEpoch] = useState(0)
40	  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState<Loaded | null>(null)
41	
42	  useEffect(() => {
43	    if (!client) return
44	    let cancelled = false
45	
46	    client
47	      .listConversations()
48	      .then((list) => {
49	        if (cancelled) return
50	        setLoaded({ client, epoch, items: list, available: true, error: null })
51	        log.info('conversations.loaded', 'rail loaded', { count: list.length })
52	      })
53	      .catch((err: unknown) => {
54	        if (cancelled) return
55	        if (isNotFound(err)) {
56	          setLoaded({ client, epoch, items: [], available: false, error: null })
57	          log.info('conversations.unavailable', 'GET /conversations is 404: history not available on this harness')
58	          return
59	        }
60	        // Keep whatever was on screen; just surface the error.
61	        setLoaded((prev) => ({
62	          client,
63	          epoch,
64	          items: prev?.items ?? [],
65	          available: prev?.available ?? null,
66	          error: String(err),
67	        }))
68	        log.warn('conversations.error', 'GET /conversations failed', { error: String(err) })
69	      })
70	
71	    return () => {
72	      cancelled = true
73	    }
74	  }, [client, epoch])
75	
76	  const refresh = useCallback(() => setEpoch((n) => n + 1), [])
77	
78	  return useMemo(() => {
79	    const current = !!client && !!loaded && loaded.client === client && loaded.epoch === epoch
80	    return {
81	      items: loaded?.items ?? [],
82	      loading: !!client && !current,
83	      error: current ? loaded.error : null,
84	      available: loaded?.available ?? null,
85	      refresh,
86	    }
87	  }, [client, loaded, epoch, refresh])
88	}

3	 * things Home needs from it: `/health` and `/scenarios`.
4	 *
5	 * Both are allowed to fail. A dead harness must still leave a usable page — the bundled replay
6	 * is the whole reason demo mode exists — so failures land in `healthError` / `scenariosError`

8	 */
9	
10	import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
11

13	import { HarnessClient } from '@/lib/api'
14	import { resolveConfig, type ResolvedConfig } from '@/lib/config'
15	import { getLogger } from '@/lib/log'

18	const log = getLogger('web')
19	
20	export interface HarnessState {
21	  /** Resolved harness origin, or null while resolving. */
22	  base: string | null
23	  /** `/health` answered and reported ok — the only gate on starting a live run. */
24	  reachable: boolean
25	  /** Where the URL came from: window | config.json | build-env | default. */

27	  health: Health | null

30	  scenariosError: string | null
31	  loading: boolean
32	  refresh: () => void
33	  /** Bound to the current identity: every request carries `X-Faultline-User`. Null until the URL resolves. */
34	  client: HarnessClient | null
35	  /** The anonymous browser id the client sends. */
36	  userId: string
37	}
38	
39	export function useHarness(): HarnessState {
40	  const { userId } = useIdentity()
41	  const [cfg, setCfg] = useState<ResolvedConfig | null>(null)
42	  const [health, setHealth] = useState<Health | null>(null)
43	  const [healthError, setHealthError] = useState<string | null>(null)
44	  const [scenarios, setScenarios] = useState<Scenario[]>([])
45	  const [scenariosError, setScenariosError] = useState<string | null>(null)
46	  /** Which (client, refresh epoch) the last probe pair settled for; `loading` derives from it. */
47	  const [settled, setSettled] = useState<{ client: HarnessClient; epoch: number } | null>(null)
48	  const [nonce, setNonce] = useState(0)
49	
50	  // 1. Resolve the base URL once.
51	  useEffect(() => {
52	    let cancelled = false
53	    void resolveConfig().then((resolved) => {
54	      if (cancelled) return
55	      setCfg(resolved)
56	      log.info('config.resolved', 'harness URL resolved', {
57	        harness_url: resolved.harnessUrl,
58	        source: resolved.source,
59	      })
60	    })
61	    return () => {
62	      cancelled = true
63	    }
64	  }, [])
65	
66	  // 2. One client per (base, identity). A reset() of the id rebuilds it.
67	  const client = useMemo(
68	    () => (cfg && cfg.harnessUrl ? new HarnessClient(cfg.harnessUrl, { userId }) : null),
69	    [cfg, userId],
70	  )
71	
72	  // 2b. No URL at all (no /config.json, no VITE_HARNESS_URL): say so instead of spinning forever.
73	  useEffect(() => {
74	    if (!cfg || cfg.harnessUrl) return
75	    setHealth(null)
76	    setHealthError('harness URL not configured (config.json or VITE_HARNESS_URL); replays still work')
77	    setScenarios([])
78	    setScenariosError(null)
79	    log.warn('config.missing', 'no harness URL configured; live runs disabled')
80	  }, [cfg])
81	
82	  // 3. Probe /health and /scenarios whenever the client changes or refresh() is called.
83	  useEffect(() => {
84	    if (!client) return
85	    let cancelled = false
86	
87	    // Deliberately NOT `await Promise.all*` before updating: a cold harness answers /health in
88	    // ~12 s while /scenarios comes back in 0.3 s (or the other way round). Coupling them would
89	    // leave the whole page on a spinner for the slower of the two, so each settles on its own.
90	    const probeHealth = client
91	      .health()
92	      .then((value) => {
93	        if (cancelled) return
94	        setHealth(value)
95	        setHealthError(null)
96	        log.info('health.ok', 'harness reachable', {
97	          model_default: value.model_default ?? null,
98	          has_provider_key: value.has_provider_key,
99	        })
100	      })
101	      .catch((err: unknown) => {
102	        if (cancelled) return
103	        setHealth(null)
104	        setHealthError(String(err))
105	        log.warn('health.error', 'harness unreachable', { error: String(err) })
106	      })
107	
108	    const probeScenarios = client
109	      .scenarios()
110	      .then((value) => {
111	        if (cancelled) return
112	        setScenarios(value)
113	        setScenariosError(null)
114	        log.info('scenarios.loaded', 'catalogue loaded', { count: value.length })
115	      })
116	      .catch((err: unknown) => {
117	        if (cancelled) return
118	        setScenarios([])
119	        setScenariosError(String(err))
120	        log.warn('scenarios.error', 'GET /scenarios failed', { error: String(err) })
121	      })
122	
123	    void Promise.all([probeHealth, probeScenarios]).then(() => {
124	      if (!cancelled) setSettled({ client, epoch: nonce })
125	    })

127	    return () => {
128	      cancelled = true
129	    }
130	  }, [client, nonce])

132	  const refresh = useCallback(() => setNonce((n) => n + 1), [])
133	
134	  // Loading until the URL resolves, and again whenever the client or the refresh epoch moves on.
135	  const loading = !cfg || (client !== null && !(settled?.client === client && settled.epoch === nonce))

137	  return {
138	    base: cfg?.harnessUrl ?? null,
139	    reachable: health?.ok === true,
140	    source: cfg?.source ?? null,
141	    health,
142	    healthError,
143	    scenarios,
144	    scenariosError,
145	    loading,
146	    refresh,
147	    client,
148	    userId,
149	  }
150	}

1	/**
2	 * Path-based routes with no router dependency.
3	 *
4	 *   /                         home
5	 *   /conversations/:id[?run=] a persisted conversation, optionally focused on one of its runs
6	 *   /runs/:id                 a bare run (no conversation context — pre-Store harness)
7	 *   /replay/:demoId           a bundled replay, no backend
8	 *
9	 * The pre-Store query forms (`/?run=<id>`, `/?demo=<id>`, `/?c=<id>`) still parse so old links
10	 * keep working; hrefFor() always emits the path form. serve.py answers unknown extension-less
11	 * paths with index.html, so deep links survive a refresh.
12	 *
13	 * Navigation is pushState/replaceState plus a custom event, so every useRoute() instance and any
14	 * plain listener re-reads the location; the browser's own popstate (back/forward) is honoured too.
15	 */
16	
17	import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'
18	
19	import { getLogger } from './log'
20	
21	const log = getLogger('web')
22	
23	export type Route =
24	  | { kind: 'home' }
25	  | { kind: 'conversation'; id: string; runId?: string | null }
26	  | { kind: 'run'; runId: string }
27	  | { kind: 'replay'; demoId: string }
28	
29	/** Dispatched on `window` after every in-app navigation (in addition to the native `popstate`). */
30	export const ROUTE_EVENT = 'faultline:route'
31	
32	const HOME: Route = { kind: 'home' }
33	
34	function decode(s: string): string {
35	  try {
36	    return decodeURIComponent(s)
37	  } catch {
38	    return s
39	  }
40	}
41	
42	function segments(pathname: string): string[] {
43	  return pathname.split('/').filter((s) => s.length > 0).map(decode)
44	}
45	
46	function params(search: string): URLSearchParams {
47	  return new URLSearchParams(search.startsWith('?') ? search.slice(1) : search)
48	}
49	
50	export function parseRoute(pathname: string, search = ''): Route {
51	  const segs = segments(pathname || '/')
52	  const q = params(search)
53	
54	  if (segs.length === 0) {
55	    // Legacy query-param routing.
56	    const c = q.get('c')
57	    const run = q.get('run')
58	    const demo = q.get('demo')
59	    if (c) return { kind: 'conversation', id: c, runId: run || null }
60	    if (run) return { kind: 'run', runId: run }
61	    if (demo) return { kind: 'replay', demoId: demo }
62	    return HOME
63	  }
64	
65	  if (segs.length === 2) {
66	    const [head, id] = segs as [string, string]
67	    if (id.length === 0) return HOME
68	    if (head === 'conversations') return { kind: 'conversation', id, runId: q.get('run') || null }
69	    if (head === 'runs') return { kind: 'run', runId: id }
70	    if (head === 'replay') return { kind: 'replay', demoId: id }
71	  }
72	
73	  return HOME
74	}
75	
76	export function hrefFor(route: Route): string {
77	  switch (route.kind) {
78	    case 'home':
79	      return '/'
80	    case 'conversation': {
81	      const base = `/conversations/${encodeURIComponent(route.id)}`
82	      return route.runId ? `${base}?run=${encodeURIComponent(route.runId)}` : base
83	    }
84	    case 'run':
85	      return `/runs/${encodeURIComponent(route.runId)}`
86	    case 'replay':
87	      return `/replay/${encodeURIComponent(route.demoId)}`
88	  }
89	}
90	
91	/** Structural equality, so callers can skip no-op navigations. */
92	export function sameRoute(a: Route, b: Route): boolean {
93	  return hrefFor(a) === hrefFor(b)
94	}
95	
96	// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- window binding
97	
98	function locationKey(): string {
99	  return `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}`
100	}
101	
102	/** The route the address bar currently shows. */
103	export function currentRoute(): Route {
104	  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return HOME
105	  return parseRoute(window.location.pathname, window.location.search)
106	}
107	
108	export interface NavigateOptions {
109	  /** Replace the current history entry instead of pushing a new one. */
110	  replace?: boolean
111	}
112	
113	export function navigate(route: Route, opts: NavigateOptions = {}): void {
114	  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return
115	  const href = hrefFor(route)
116	  // Pushing an entry identical to the current one only makes Back a no-op; replace instead.
117	  const replace = opts.replace === true || href === locationKey()
118	  try {
119	    if (replace) window.history.replaceState({}, '', href)
120	    else window.history.pushState({}, '', href)
121	  } catch (err) {
122	    // history can throw in sandboxed/srcdoc frames; the in-memory route still updates below.
123	    log.warn('route.history_error', 'history update failed', { href, error: String(err) })
124	  }
125	  log.info('route.change', replace ? 'replaced' : 'navigated', { href, kind: route.kind })
126	  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent<Route>(ROUTE_EVENT, { detail: route }))
127	}
128	
129	/** Fires on back/forward and after navigate(). */
130	export function subscribeRoute(fn: () => void): () => void {
131	  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {}
132	  window.addEventListener('popstate', fn)
133	  window.addEventListener(ROUTE_EVENT, fn)
134	  return () => {
135	    window.removeEventListener('popstate', fn)
136	    window.removeEventListener(ROUTE_EVENT, fn)
137	  }
138	}
139	
140	// Snapshot must be referentially stable for an unchanged location, or useSyncExternalStore
141	// would re-render forever.
142	let cache: { key: string; route: Route } | null = null
143	
144	function getSnapshot(): Route {
145	  const key = locationKey()
146	  if (cache && cache.key === key) return cache.route
147	  cache = { key, route: parseRoute(window.location.pathname, window.location.search) }
148	  return cache.route
149	}
150	
151	function getServerSnapshot(): Route {
152	  return HOME
153	}
154	
155	/** The current Route; re-renders on navigate() and on the browser's back/forward. */
156	export function useRoute(): Route {
157	  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribeRoute, getSnapshot, getServerSnapshot)
158	}
